name: Baglioni Resort Sardinia
insider_take: This exclusive resort sits on Sardinia's pristine Costa Smeralda, where emerald waters meet luxury Italian hospitality in one of the Mediterranean's most coveted destinations.
whats_special: The resort occupies a prime position along the legendary Costa Smeralda, developed by Prince Karim Aga Khan IV in the 1960s as Europe's premier luxury playground. The property features authentic Sardinian architecture with traditional granite stones and juniper wood, while the nearby Porto Cervo remains a billionaire's paradise and superyacht capital of the Mediterranean.
pro_tip: Visit during late spring or early fall to enjoy the famous Costa Smeralda beaches without the peak summer crowds, when the water temperature is still perfect and restaurant reservations are easier to secure.
dont_miss: The nearby Maddalena Archipelago National Park, accessible by boat, offers some of the clearest waters in the Mediterranean. Also explore the ancient Nuragic civilization sites scattered across Sardinia - these mysterious Bronze Age stone towers are found nowhere else on Earth and predate Stonehenge.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on Costa Smeralda
Exceptional fine dining with local Sardinian cuisine
cons: Remote island location requires additional travel planning
